question: Can semantic resources, exact evidence provenance and reconciliation make concurrent durable work fail safely under drift and partial failure?
hypothesis: Read/write semantic resources plus tree-bound trusted evidence and a non-destructive doctor will detect hidden concurrency conflicts, stale evidence and inconsistent WORK state before integration.

conditions.acceptance: trusted evidence must match the exact decision tree
conditions.doctor: read-only by default; repair only performs safe synchronization

observations: asserted evidence was rejected for acceptance
observed evidence became invalid after the Git tree changed
revalidation on the new tree allowed acceptance
semantic write/read collision was detected across disjoint file scopes
doctor detected malformed active WORK without inventing a repair
doctor --repair synchronized refs/notes and completed healthy on repository state
remote durable handoff remained successful with observed tree-bound evidence
evidence.discoveredFailure: double evidence normalization initially dropped subject.tree; chaos CI exposed it and UG-0019 was revised to make normalization idempotent
